global_style: Vibrant, brutalist punk presentation style featuring high-contrast colors, oversized typography, overlapping layouts, and signature chamfered geometric shapes.

identity_anchors: Oversized, widely-spaced typography intersecting and overlapping images
Solid rectangular containers with a single pronounced chamfered/cut corner
Asymmetrical, layered brutalist composition breaking standard grid alignments
Persistent branding badge anchored to the bottom-left corner across all slides

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
